decision: The banners on feature01 (1820:3053) and feature02 (1820:3097), and feature03's conclusion (1820:3142), are one shared component `banner`, node 1820:2827. feature02 and conclusion are detached copies of it in Figma; they keep their position in each page's sections but are built from the component. Rules out one banner file per page.

The header's btn-contact (671:46) is treated as the same button as the catalogue's button-contact (1602:5418), listed once in components with design 1602:5418. Rules out a second contact-button component. Revisit if the header's button measures differently from 1602:5418.

topic: Sitemap merged from draft; SEO copy unconfirmed
decision: docs/project.json sitemap is merged unchanged from docs/project.draft.json (10 pages, 56 sections). Every title/description is the agent's draft from textSample, not the client's copy; aimes, feature01 and feature02 are the weakest. The header is a detached frame repeated on all 10 pages and only the top page's node (1517:3978) was taken; identity across pages is unchecked.

topic: No SP design: small screen is built by the agent
decision: The designer will not supply SP artboards (answers Q1 of the design analysis). No section has a designSP, so TW-25 applies to every section: the agent derives the small screen from the PC node and writes both widths in one pass, including lg:/xl:/pc: (mq() on bem). Width taken off a frame is capped, not fixed. spWidth stays 390 as the root re-anchor width only. Rules out waiting for SP frames.

topic: Noto Sans JP stands in for Avenir and Avenir Next
decision: Avenir and Avenir Next (eyebrows, numerals, header nav at 12px) have no web licence. The client chose Noto Sans JP for both, so the token step sets one family and does not bring Avenir in. Outfit, used by the numbered circles in the design, is web-licensed and is a separate question not covered here. Rules out licensing Avenir or substituting Montserrat.

topic: Header contact buttons stay in the header; D-002 superseded
decision: The header has no btn-contact instance: its two buttons (自動見積り 153x40, お問合せ 95x40) are detached rectangles and stay as the header's own markup. D-002 is superseded. Component button-contact now points at 671:46, the btn-contact the pages place; 1602:5418 is placed by no page. Rules out a shared small white button.

topic: Components merged per the design analysis
decision: banner-aimes folds into banner (1820:2827); faq-question and faq-answer into faq-item (1215:5249, open state); navigation-button01-04 into number-card (1820:3203), which the analysis also uses for faq-category-button01-04 and the four solution cards on top (17 uses).
